name: pacstrap
description: Install packages into a new root

options.name: -C
options.description: Use an alternate config file for pacman

options.name: -c
options.description: Use the package cache on the host, rather than the target

options.name: -G
options.description: Avoid copying the host's pacman keyring to the target

options.name: -i
options.description: Prompt for package confirmation when needed (run interactively)

options.name: -K
options.description: Initialize an empty pacman keyring in the target (implies '-G')

options.name: -M
options.description: Avoid copying the host's mirrorlist to the target

options.name: -N
options.description: Run in unshare mode as a regular user

options.name: -P
options.description: Copy the host's pacman config to the target
